name: Kexcelled (North Bridge New Material Technology (Suzhou) Co., Ltd.)
summary: Suzhou-based filament and resin manufacturer selling directly under the Kexcelled brand, with an unusually strong certification profile for a value-priced Chinese producer (ISO 9001, ISO 13485 medical QMS, FDA and CE-MDR Class I, UL 94 V0 on select materials) and manufacturing diversified beyond China into Thailand.

product_lines.name: THE K5™ PLA / PLA-P / PLA5
product_lines.notes: Base/economy PLA grade; PLA-P and PLA5 are sub-variants of the same base, and no public TDS confirms a toughened (PLA+) formulation.

product_lines.name: K5 Matte PLA (incl. Light Wood tones)
product_lines.notes: Matte-additive PLA; "light wood" SKUs are wood-tone pigment only, not wood-fiber filled.

product_lines.name: PLA Wood
product_lines.notes: Genuine wood-fiber-filled PLA, a separate SKU from the wood-tone matte.

product_lines.name: THE K5™ WOOD (Textured Series)
product_lines.notes: Textured wood-feel line; base polymer not stated on public pages, PLA assumed by analogy with the PLA Wood SKU.

product_lines.name: PC (Functional series)
product_lines.notes: Polycarbonate; some grades UL 94 V0 rated.

product_lines.name: Support (Functional series)
product_lines.notes: Breakaway/support material; solubility not stated, so neither pva nor bvoh can be assigned.

product_lines.name: High Speed TPU 95A-HF
product_lines.notes: Shore 95A TPU reformulated for high-flow/high-speed printing.

product_lines.name: High Speed TPU 64D
product_lines.notes: Shore 64D rigid-flex TPU; tpu-68d carries "TPU 64D" as an alias.

product_lines.name: Flexible series — Low Shore (60A-70A) / Mid Shore (75A-85A) / High Shore (90A-77D)
product_lines.notes: Range is published by shore band rather than named SKUs and spans both TPU and TPE grades, so individual shore-graded ids (tpu-60a/85a/90a/95a/60d) cannot be assigned to specific products from public listings.

product_lines.name: High-Performance series (Engineering / Special Engineering)
product_lines.notes: Category exists on the product listing but constituent product names and chemistries are not published; kexcelled3d.com and kexcelled.nl block automated fetches.

additional_notes: HQ upgraded in Suzhou in 2024; manufacturing at Nantong (since 2023) and Suzhou, plus a Thailand factory launched in 2025 — one of the few producers in this cluster with genuine non-China capacity. A Germany office is planned for 2026. Also produces photopolymer resins across Dental, Consumer, Professional, Garage Kit and Jewelry ranges, including the proprietary MOLEGRID resin (2018). Certifications: ISO 9001 (2019), FDA approval and CE-MDR Class I (2023), ISO 13485:2016 (2026), RoHS/REACH-SVHC/TSCA/Prop 65 compliance. Company reports 600+ employees, sales in 60+ countries and 40+ patents. Sold heavily via Alibaba and Amazon, often on Bambu Lab-compatible spools. No OEM relationship to any brand in the verified-OEM network was found. Build plates not confirmed, so makes_plates is left unset. A YouTube presence exists (video vKLeQXW7OQI) but the canonical channel URL was not verified, so it is omitted from endpoints.social.

provenance.conflicts: Legal entity (North Bridge New Material Technology (Suzhou) Co., Ltd.) rests on a single Alibaba company overview. Price tier is a judgement call on a budget/mid boundary — no verified $/kg figures were found.
